en.title: What's new and planned for Dynamics 365 Business Central
en.summary: Summary of planned features for Dynamics 365 Business Central.
en.details:
### Application

In 2022 release wave 1, we deliver updates based on the most popular requests for improvement. We'll invest in better reporting, and several improvements to the supply chain area. May 11, 2022 Release and reopen multiple documents Users, automatically Mar 1, 2022 Jul 7, 2022

### Better with Microsoft 365

In 2022 release wave 1, we invest in a stronger reporting story, including better integration with Excel. We also improve the support for collaborative business processes in Teams so you can bring Business Central pages into a Teams channel. Feature Enabled for Public preview General availability Enhancements to Microsoft Teams integration Users, automatically - Apr 1, 2022 Outlook add-in – add email attachments to Business Central records Users, automatically Feb 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Share a file through OneDrive Users, automatically Mar 7, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Outlook add-in popout window enhancements Users, automatically Mar 9, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 A single tile to go to Business Central Users, automatically - Aug 1, 2022

### Development

We continue to invest in a rich spectrum of extensibility tooling capabilities for developers, including making the AL language even stronger, providing developers with a great experience. Feature Enabled for Public preview General availability Demo tool and demo data for manufacturing scenarios Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically - Apr 1, 2022 Isolated events Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically - Apr 1, 2022 New isolated event OnCompanyOpenCompleted Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically - Apr 1, 2022 New reporting events Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically - Apr 1, 2022 In-client performance profiler Users, automatically Mar 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Multiple layouts of the same type in reports and report extensions Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically Mar 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Telemetry - monitor health and uptake of features Users by admins, makers, or analysts Mar 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Ability to elevate permissions in AL code Users, automatically Apr 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 AL-Go for GitHub - modern DevOps for partners Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically Apr 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Deploy dependent projects in workspace Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically Apr 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Telemetry - company name as a custom dimension in AL LogMessage Users, automatically Apr 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Telemetry - votes on whether error messages are useful Users, automatically Apr 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Users can export report datasets to XML Users, automatically Apr 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Get warned by AppSourceCop if your code validates against an obsolete version Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically Jun 1, 2022 Jun 1, 2022

### Governance and administration

Business Central 2022 release wave 1 delivers a set of admin and governance capabilities to help admins and IT pros set up, secure, manage, govern, and monitor customer environments. Feature Enabled for Public preview General availability Security administrators can define default permission set assignments when users sign up Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically Feb 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Set user email policies to control who can read email sent from Business Central Users by admins, makers, or analysts Mar 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Support for granular delegated admin privileges (GDAP) Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically Mar 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Telemetry for environment lifecycle events Users, automatically Apr 30, 2022 Apr 30, 2022 Telemetry for permission error dialogs Users, automatically Apr 1, 2022 May 1, 2022 Improved settings for managing updates Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically - May 15, 2022 Send email as current user using SMTP connector Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically Jul 11, 2022 Aug 5, 2022

### Microsoft Power Platform

In 2022 release wave 1, we improved the integration with Microsoft Dataverse and Microsoft Power Platform. Feature Enabled for Public preview General availability Dataverse data change events Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically Apr 2, 2022 - Action group to run chosen instant Power Automate flow Users by admins, makers, or analysts Apr 1, 2022 May 16, 2022 Improvements to the Power Automate and Power Apps connector Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically Apr 1, 2022 May 16, 2022 Business Central connector enabled in Power BI Dataflows Users, automatically Jun 16, 2022 Jul 11, 2022

### Modern clients

In 2022 release wave 1, we make improvements to our extensive portfolio of clients with the focus on better usability, accessibility, performance, and stability. Feature Enabled for Public preview General availability Copy link from Share menu Users, automatically Feb 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Control add-in resiliency Users, automatically Mar 9, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Usability improvements to the web client Users, automatically Mar 9, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 New desktop app delivering full web client experience on desktop is listed in the Microsoft Store Users, automatically Mar 1, 2022 Apr 3, 2022

### Onboarding

Onboarding is a key focus in every release wave. The aim is to make the onboarding of new customers faster, but also the onboarding of new users. Feature Enabled for Public preview General availability Context-aware links in the Help pane from Microsoft and partners Users, automatically Mar 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Guided tour that helps users find settings and personalization tools Users, automatically Mar 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Support for rich text in teaching tips and tours Users, automatically Mar 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Tour of the Role Explorer and how to filter it Users, automatically Mar 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Telemetry - user checklist status changes are logged to telemetry Users, automatically Apr 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022

### Reporting

Reporting is top-of-mind for many business users, as a way to get insight into new growth opportunities and also as a way to share data as a foundation for business planning discussions. Feature Enabled for Public preview General availability New capabilities for financial reporting with account schedules Users, automatically Mar 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 New pages for report layout administration Users, automatically Apr 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Use Excel to design layouts for reports Users, automatically Apr 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022

### Service and platform

No matter the industry type of a small or medium-sized business SMB, business users expect a dependable service and platform that they can run their business on. Feature Enabled for Public preview General availability Performance-related insights into missing indexes Users, automatically Mar 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Performance - partners can get insights into database wait statistics Users, automatically Apr 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Telemetry - error dialogs are logged to telemetry Users, automatically Apr 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Telemetry - stopping a session is logged to telemetry Users, automatically Apr 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Telemetry - support engineers can now see user IDs in telemetry Users, automatically Apr 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Telemetry - the action of enabling detailed telemetry is logged to telemetry Users, automatically Apr 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Telemetry - when a database deadlock occurs, it is logged to telemetry Users, automatically Apr 1, 2022 Apr 1, 2022 Get telemetry on dependency cycles in permission sets Users, automatically May 2, 2022 May 2, 2022 Description of Enabled for column values: Users, automatically: These features include changes to the user experience and are enabled automatically. Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically: These features are meant to be used by administrators, makers, marketers, or business analysts and are enabled automatically. Users by admins, makers, or analysts: These features must be enabled or configured by the administrators, makers, or business analysts to be available for their users. For a list of the countries or regions where Dynamics 365 business applications are available, go to the International availability guide. For more information about geographic areas and datacenters (regions), go to the Dynamics 365 and Microsoft Power Platform availability page.

### Udvikling

Vi fortsætter med at investere i et omfattende spektrum af udvidelsesmuligheder i værktøjsfunktioner til udviklere, herunder i at gøre AL-sproget endnu stærkere, hvilket giver udviklere en god oplevelse. ### Styring og administration

Business Central, udgivelsesbølge 1 i 2022 leverer et sæt administrator- og styringsfunktioner, der er designet til at hjælpe administratorer og it-professionelle med at konfigurere, sikre, administrere, styre og overvåge kundemiljøer. Funktion Aktiveret for Offentlig forhåndsversion Generel tilgængelighed Sikkerhedsadministratoren kan definere tildelinger af standardrettighedssæt, når brugerne tilmelder sig Administratorer, producenter, marketingmedarbejdere eller analytikere, automatisk 1. februar 2022 1. april 2022 Indstil brugermailpolitikker for at kontrollere, hvem der kan læse mail, der er sendt fra Business Central Brugere efter administratorer, producenter eller analytikere 1. marts 2022 1. april 2022 Understøttelse af detaljerede delegerede administratorrettigheder (GDAP) Administratorer, producenter, marketingmedarbejdere eller analytikere, automatisk 1. marts 2022 1. april 2022 Telemetri til miljølivscyklushændelser Brugere, automatisk 30. april 2022 30. april 2022 Telemetri for tilladelsesfejldialoger Brugere, automatisk 1. april 2022 1. maj 2022 Forbedrede indstillinger til styring af opdateringer Administratorer, producenter, marketingmedarbejdere eller analytikere, automatisk - 15. maj 2022 Sende mail som nuværende bruger vha. SMTP-connector Administratorer, producenter, marketingmedarbejdere eller analytikere, automatisk 11. juli 2022 5. august 2022

### Microsoft Power Platform

I udgivelsesbølge 1 i 2022 forbedrer vi integrationen med Microsoft Dataverse og Microsoft Power Platform. Funktion Aktiveret for Offentlig forhåndsversion Generel tilgængelighed Dataverse-dataændringshændelser Administratorer, producenter, marketingmedarbejdere eller analytikere, automatisk 2. april 2022 - Handlingsgruppe til at køre det valgte øjeblikkelige Power Automate-flow Brugere efter administratorer, producenter eller analytikere 1. april 2022 16. maj 2022 Forbedringer i Power Automate- og Power Apps-connectoren Administratorer, producenter, marketingmedarbejdere eller analytikere, automatisk 1. april 2022 16. maj 2022 Business Central-connector aktiveret i Power BI-dataflow Brugere, automatisk 16. juni 2022 11. juli 2022

### Moderne klienter

Med udgivelsesbølge 1 i 2022 forbedrer vi vores omfattende portefølje af klienter med fokus på bedre brugervenlighed, tilgængelighed, ydeevne og stabilitet. Funktion Aktiveret for Offentlig forhåndsversion Generel tilgængelighed Kopiér link fra menuen Del Brugere, automatisk 1. februar 2022 1. april 2022 Robusthed af tilføjelseskontrolelement Brugere, automatisk 9. marts 2022 1. april 2022 Forbedringer af anvendeligheden af webklienten Brugere, automatisk 9. marts 2022 1. april 2022 Ny skrivebordsapp, der leverer fuld webklientoplevelse på skrivebordet, er opført i Microsoft Store Brugere, automatisk 1. marts 2022 3. april 2022

### Onboarding

Onboarding er et centralt fokus i hver udgivelsesbølge. Målet er ikke blot at gøre onboarding af nye kunder hurtigere, men også onboarding af nye brugere. Funktion Aktiveret for Offentlig forhåndsversion Generel tilgængelighed Kontekstafhængige link i ruden Hjælp fra Microsoft og partnere Brugere, automatisk 1. marts 2022 1. april 2022 Guidet tur, der hjælper brugere med at finde indstillinger og brugertilpasningsværktøjer Brugere, automatisk 1. marts 2022 1. april 2022 Understøttelse til RTF-tekst i undervisningstip og rundture Brugere, automatisk 1. marts 2022 1. april 2022 Præsentation af rollestifinderen, og hvordan man filtrerer den Brugere, automatisk 1. marts 2022 1. april 2022 Telemetri - ændringer af status med brugertjekliste logges til telemetri Brugere, automatisk 1. april 2022 1. april 2022

### Rapportering

Rapportering er øverst på listen for mange forretningsbrugere, som en måde at få indsigt ind i nye vækstmuligheder og også som en måde at dele data på som grundlag for forretningsplanlægningsdiskussioner. Funktion Aktiveret for Offentlig forhåndsversion Generel tilgængelighed Nye muligheder for finansiel rapportering med kontoplaner Brugere, automatisk 1. marts 2022 1. april 2022 Nye sider til rapportlayoutadministration Brugere, automatisk 1. april 2022 1. april 2022 Bruge Excel til at designe layout til rapporter Brugere, automatisk 1. april 2022 1. april 2022

### Service og platform

Uanset hvilken branchetype der er tale om for en lille eller mellemstor virksomhed (SMV), forventer forretningsbrugerne en pålidelig service og platform, som de kan køre deres forretning på.
